input_roles.image_1: Edit target: approved GODO apron, shirt and torso proportions. Replace awkward two-handed waist strap pulling.
input_roles.image_2: Reference only for clean photographic realism, warm upper-right natural light and neutral grey-white wall. Do not include this face or compose a portrait.

description: Candid final adjustment while putting on the apron before drawing. Crop from below the chin to upper hips. The woman stands in a relaxed slight three-quarter position. Her nearer right hand is raised naturally and lightly pinches the reinforced top corner of the apron bib beside the neck strap attachment, using thumb and index finger only. The contact must be clearly visible: thumb behind cloth, index finger on front, three remaining fingers softly curled with anatomical joints and short natural nails. Bib is barely lifted, not stretched. Other arm rests naturally downward, hand out of frame. Waist ties already lie flat around the waist, tied behind her, entirely out of view. No pulling straps, no loose tails, no invented cords. Logo and GODO fully visible below the hand. This depicts a small everyday adjustment, not a posed display.
